name: codex-dsh-desktop
description: Control DSH Desktop through scoped chat, answer-only verification and explicitly delegated tasks; read actual completion evidence and deduplicate retries.

interface.shortDescription: Send scoped DSH tasks and read their actual results.
interface.longDescription: Uses the installed DSH prompt plugin's local session bridge. Separates explicit chat, verification and delegated work; removes tools during verification, restores prompts and reads actual replies without duplicate handoffs.
interface.defaultPrompt: 检查DSH桌面的连接和插件版本，明确区分聊天、验证和委派任务。
